housing.summary: Brisbane's 1-bedroom apartment in the city centre typically rents for approximately AUD 450–550 per week. Queensland's Residential Tenancies Act caps the bond at 4 weeks rent. Primary rental portals are realestate.com.au and domain.com.au.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Australia, new arrivals typically need a valid passport, proof of Australian address, and a Tax File Number (TFN). CommBank allows account opening up to 14 days before arrival. ANZ and NAB also serve new residents. In-branch ID verification within 20 days of opening is required by CommBank.
required_docs: Valid passport (original required for in-branch ID verification within 20 days)

schools.summary: Brisbane has international schools offering IB, British, and American curricula. The national school directory myschool.edu.au lists all Queensland schools. Queensland state schools fall under the Department of Education Queensland (qed.qld.gov.au).

legal_admin.summary: Visa holders in Australia must notify the Department of Home Affairs of any address changes. New residents should register with myGov (my.gov.au) to link ATO, Medicare, and Centrelink services.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register with myGov; notify Home Affairs of address changes

tax_finance.summary: All workers and income earners in Australia require a Tax File Number (TFN) from the Australian Taxation Office (ATO). Apply online for free at ato.gov.au.

transport.summary: Brisbane public transport is operated by Translink (Queensland Government) using the go card or contactless payments. As of 2024, Queensland introduced a 50-cent flat fare across all Translink services, regardless of distance. Overseas licence holders may drive in Queensland on a foreign licence; upon becoming a resident, conversion to a Queensland licence via TMR is required. Medicare registration for eligible visa holders via Services Australia.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Queensland residents must convert their overseas licence to a Queensland licence via Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR). No fixed time limit but required upon becoming a resident.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible visa holders enrol in Medicare at Services Australia offices or online via servicesaustralia.gov.au/medicare.
